text:
alyssa (eng-platform): Quick sync — we need to finalize the slot manager metrics to expose in Console for Hosted + Dedicated pools. Key asks: SM occupancy, per-SM memory usage, queue depth and a lightweight headroom signal. Can we agree on names/labels, retention, and which team owns ingestion/alerts?

tom (eng-runtime): I can standardize names. Proposal: `gpu_sm_occupancy{pool,hosted_or_dedicated,model_family}`, `gpu_sm_memory_bytes{pool,hosted_or_dedicated}`, `gpu_sm_queue_depth{pool,priority}`. Keep tags small.

devon (eng-infra): Those look good. Two infra notes: (1) ingestion path will go through telemetry-pipeline v2, so we need schema + max cardinality estimate. (2) For Dedicated pools we tag `customer_id` but we must throttle/aggregate to avoid high cardinality.

maria (eng-sre): For alerting we want a headroom metric, not raw occupancy. Suggest `gpu_sm_headroom_pct{pool}` = 1 - max(occupancy, queue_load). We can derive it in Prometheus/Query layer but would prefer an ingest-time gauge if it simplifies dashboards.

jun (console): From Console UX: we need per-pool timeseries (1m/5m), heatmap for occupancy, and a stacked bar for queue depth by priority. Retention: 90 days for perf troubleshooting, 14 days for detailed per-SM if cost is high. Also want an API surface to fetch top-k congested hosts for the pool.

telemetry-bot: NOTE: telemetry-pipeline v2 limits cardinality to ~10k active label combos per metric by default. Use `pool` + `hosted_or_dedicated` + `priority` sparingly.

anu (product): Just to add context — Dedicated customers asked for 30d per-SM history for billing/diagnostics. Hosted can be more aggregated.

alyssa (eng-platform): Action items suggestion: 1) tom & devon agree metric names + label whitelist, 2) infra to provide cardinality estimates and config for telemetry-pipeline, 3) jun to draft Console wireframes for heatmap + top-k table, 4) maria to propose alert rules (headroom thresholds) for canary.

tom (eng-runtime): I will prepare a schema PR with example payload and PromQL-friendly names. Sample metrics in the PR: 
```
# occupancy as fraction of SM lanes in use (0..1)
metric: gpu_sm_occupancy
labels: pool, hosted_or_dedicated, sm_id
value: 0.72

# memory in bytes per SM
metric: gpu_sm_memory_bytes
labels: pool, hosted_or_dedicated, sm_id
value: 123456789

# queue depth (# of pending in queue)
metric: gpu_sm_queue_depth
labels: pool,hosted_or_dedicated, priority
value: 7
```

devon (eng-infra): For cardinality: estimate 500 pools * avg 20 SMs * 2 hosted/dedicated = 20k sm_id combos => too many. We should avoid `sm_id` at ingestion for long retention. Suggest: ingest per-host aggregations: `host_id` and `pool`, and sample per-sm details at 1/10 rate into a high-cardinality store.

maria (eng-sre): Agree with devon. For alerting we only need per-host or per-pool aggregates. Keep per-sm detail for debugging only (short retention).

jun (console): Wireframe note: heatmap rows = host, cols = pool; color = occupancy pct. Top-k table shows host, occupancy, mem used, queue depth, last_seen. We'll need an API endpoint that returns top-k by occupancy in last 5m.

alyssa (eng-platform): Decision draft: ingest aggregate metrics: `gpu_sm_occupancy{pool,host_id,hosted_or_dedicated}`, `gpu_sm_memory_bytes{pool,host_id...}`, and `gpu_sm_queue_depth{pool,host_id,priority}` with 90d for aggregates. Per-SM detail ingested as sampled traces (1/10) to high-card store with 14d retention. Does everyone agree?

devon (eng-infra): +1 but we need quotas: set per-tenant write rate limits and sampling controls for Dedicated customers to opt-in full-detail. I'll add config knobs.

maria (eng-sre): +1. For alerts: propose two rules: (1) pool_headroom_pct < 0.15 for 5m -> page SRE, (2) sustained queue_depth > X for 10m -> warn. I'll sketch thresholds after we see initial telemetry.

tom (eng-runtime): I'll open PR with schema + example agent payload + ingestion flag `detailed_sampling=0.1` by EOD tomorrow.

jun (console): I'll put a draft mockup in Figma and an API contract for top-k (limit, pool, timeframe) by Fri.

alyssa (eng-platform): Great. Owners: tom (schema + runtime), devon (ingest + quotas), jun (console), maria (alerts), alyssa (coord). Reopening if anyone needs a different scope. :thumbsup:
